clips.title: Completion
paras: I am afraid I have bad news for you, friend. This egg is too far gone. I can take it from you so that it may be disposed of properly.
Please don't be discouraged; we cannot save them all. If you find yourself in Feralas again, please try again. Bring another egg for the Super Egg-O-Matic!
